text: In a forest lived a rabbit. Wandering all day long, all he did was jump, hop, and admire himself. He loved talking about how much faster he was than the other animals. "I'm the fastest animal in the forest. Would anyone like to race with me?" He sure did run fast with his very big feet. The other animals hated the way he would show off.
